product_metadata.title: Oubonun 26 x 26 Pillow Inserts (Set of 2) - Throw Pillow Inserts with 100% Cotton Cover - 26 Inch Square Interior Sofa Pillow Inserts - Decorative Pillow Insert Pair - White Couch Pillow
features: PILLOW INSERT 26x26:The package includes 2 pieces of 26 by 26-inch pillow inserts with a Cotton Cover, which is breathable and skin-friendly.
WELL MADE： Our decorative pillows have a 100% cotton cover and sufficient 3D high-quality fillings, so they are durable, soft yet firm enough for back support, providing the best experience for you.
WIDELY USE: Great cushion, sham stuffers for inserting into your favorite throw pillow covers to add accents to your room's déco, Versatile for chair, bed, couch, sofa, office, car, etc.

COMFORTABLE: Our throw pillow inserts are soft and fluffy, providing suitable softness and firmness. When you lie down, lean on, hold in your arms, read or watch TV, they help you feel comfortable and relieved.

EASILY CARE: The pillows will be shipped vacuum packaged and need a couple of hours to fluff up to full shape. Machine wash gentle cycle, mild detergent, and tumble dry low heat; a hidden zipper and cloth flap keep all the fill in place.
